svg.aria-label: Illustrative three-year cost of an AEM program as stacked layers. Above the waterline is the licence, which most business cases focus on. Below it are build, migration, the run team, and hidden costs such as content migration, integrations, training, content request overage and a second CDN. Proportions are illustrative, not a benchmark.
svg.text: Where the money goes over three years
The licence is the part everyone sees. Proportions below are illustrative, not a benchmark.
Assets, Dynamic Media, Forms, Extended Security, environments
Components or blocks, templates, integrations, testing
Usually the biggest single number in year one
Code refactoring, content transfer, parallel running
Product owner, developers, QA, DevOps, support, monitoring
Continuous regression replaces upgrade projects; the team doesn't disappear
Content migration and clean-up · integrations nobody listed · authoring training
Content request overage · a second CDN · extra environments · multi-site governance
